negative_examples: A plain 'tap target creature' (no 'up to', exactly one) atom must keep requiring exactly one target as today
A caster must not be able to legally select a 4th target on Tidal Surge even though the current cast-time check only validates each supplied target individually
capability.required_behavior: validateSpellTargetSelection enforces a declared inclusive target count before casting spends resources. ToGameCard preserves target.min_targets=0 and target.max_targets=3 into the SpellEffect stub for one targeted spell-sequence atom. Tidal Surge permits 0..3 distinct legal nonflying_creature targets; Sea Gods Scorn uses the same bounds with creature_or_enchantment and existing bounce. Reject four targets, duplicates and illegal types before mutation. All existing casting paths that validate SpellTargetType use the same check. Revalidate bounded target legality at resolution, skipping illegal members and fizzling when all chosen targets become illegal. Ordinary required-target spells remain required; no-bounds legacy multi-target contracts are unchanged.
